title: Order reversal transports coherent adjunction data
statement:
Use quasicategories, coherent functors, internal functor simplicial sets and coherent comma categories of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], coherent adjunction data of [def-coef-coherent-adjunction-data], and the opposite simplicial sets and mapping-space comparisons of [lem-coef-infinity-op-mapping-reversal]. Work in a fixed containing universe. Let $L:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ and $R:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$ be coherent functors equipped with coherent adjunction data $L\dashv R$, with unit $\eta:\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal A}\to RL$, counit $\epsilon:LR\to\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal B}$, both specified triangle $2$-simplices, and the specified initial and terminal universal-arrow conditions. Then order reversal transports these data to coherent adjunction data $R^{\mathrm{op}}\dashv L^{\mathrm{op}}$. The new unit is $\epsilon^{\mathrm{op}}:\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal B^{\mathrm{op}}}\to L^{\mathrm{op}}R^{\mathrm{op}}$, and the new counit is $\eta^{\mathrm{op}}:R^{\mathrm{op}}L^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal A^{\mathrm{op}}}$. Under the canonical isomorphisms
$$\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal A,\mathcal B)^{\mathrm{op}}\cong\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal A^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal B^{\mathrm{op}}),\qquad\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal B,\mathcal A)^{\mathrm{op}}\cong\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal B^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal A^{\mathrm{op}}),$$
the reversed original right triangle is the new left triangle and the reversed original left triangle is the new right triangle. For every $a\in\mathcal A$ and $b\in\mathcal B$ the canonical isomorphisms
$$(a\downarrow R)^{\mathrm{op}}\cong(R^{\mathrm{op}}\downarrow a),\qquad(L\downarrow b)^{\mathrm{op}}\cong(b\downarrow L^{\mathrm{op}})$$
carry $(La,\eta_a)$ to the terminal universal arrow for the reversed counit and $(Rb,\epsilon_b)$ to the initial universal arrow for the reversed unit. These identifications retain all simplices of the unit, counit and triangle diagrams and commute with restriction of their parameter simplices. Applying reversal twice returns the original data.

source.place: Definition 6.2.1.1 (02EK), the two triangle conditions, together with Construction 1.4.2.2 and Remarks 1.4.2.3 and 1.4.2.7 (003L), order reversal. Agent-formulated transport of the specified coherent adjunction data and universal comma objects. Read online 2026-10-17, not archived; these are Kerodon identifiers, not Stacks tags.
